name: Gemma fine-tuning for NLP exam report

mentions.name: Gemma fine-tuning for NLP exam report
mentions.description: An academic project fine-tuning Gemma language models for an NLP exam, resulting in a written report; the author found the field still lacks documentation and examples.
mentions.problem: Fine-tuning Gemma models has sparse documentation and examples, making it hard to know where to start in an immature, fast-moving field.
mentions.source_excerpt: I tried to fine tune some gemma models and wow, I have to say that there's still a lot to do in terms of documentation, examples, whatever.
